label: default agent • create a daily schedule (declarative apply)
query: Create a daily schedule named "Morning Brief" for the agent "Eval Reporter Agent" at 08:00 that summarizes my unread news.
notes: osaurus_config apply with a schedules entry (name, agent by name, instructions, frequency 'daily', frequency_time_of_day). The referenced agent is seeded so create SUCCEEDS (the happy path: correct daily mapping + a real schedule) rather than looping on a not-found agent — the agent is torn down after the case. The selection assertion pins the apply + the daily frequency inside the document.
